head: Waze now warns drivers about nearby cyclists using Garmin LiveTrack
dek: Cyclists who turn on Garmin LiveTrack on a Garmin bike computer or watch can choose to appear in Waze, and drivers get an alert when one is nearby.
details: It's opt-in. Drivers only see a temporary alert; a cyclist's name, identity and exact route aren't shared, and the alerts stop when the ride ends. It's rolling out worldwide on iPhone and Android.
where: Waze on iPhone and Android, worldwide
means: Drivers get a heads-up to slow down, and cyclists with a Garmin can make themselves visible.
todo: Cyclists: turn on LiveTrack in Garmin Connect and choose to share with Waze; drivers just keep Waze updated.
